levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: the first branch ends at «عن الأعمش» and the second at «قالا حدثنا الأعمش»: both meet at al-Amash, so he is in the shared tail after the «قالا»
«أبي» in «حدثنا أبي» is Ibn Numayr's father, a relation link (the second occurrence of the string, since «أبي شيبة» and «أبي وائل» also contain it)
the saying is Aisha's own words
